name: Boukoku no Courtisane
original_name: 亡国のクルティザンヌ
source:
An "immoral pure love novel" about a boy prostitute and an orphan girl, which evolved from the previous work of the developer, [url=/v15862]Dahlia[/url].

[Translated from [url=https://ec.toranoana.jp/tora_r/ec/item/040030373699/]Toranoana[/url]]

The setting is 19th century France.

Under the reign of Napoleon III, Paris under the Second French Empire was moving rapidly toward modernity with the hosting of the world fair and a major remodeling of the city.

Meanwhile, in the shadow of the City of Flowers (Paris), the underside of high society, the "demi monde", flourished. Women known as "courtisanes" (high-class prostitutes) exerted a profound influence on everything from culture to politics and the economy.

On a certain summer morning in 1861, Lord Lalonde picks up a beautiful woman, who was walking barefoot despite getting wet in the rain, on a bridge over the Seine. However, her true identity was that of a crossdressing male prostitute who drives men mad and destroys them.

[Translated from the [url=http://burstgen.com/boukoku/story.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
这是一部关于男妓与孤儿少女的“不道德纯爱小说”，由开发者此前的作品[url=/v15862]《Dahlia》[/url]发展而来。

[翻译自[url=https://ec.toranoana.jp/tora_r/ec/item/040030373699/]虎之穴[/url]]

故事发生在19世纪的法国。

拿破仑三世统治时期，第二法兰西帝国治下的巴黎随着举办世界博览会和大规模城市改造，迅速走向现代化。

与此同时，在“鲜花之都”巴黎的阴影中，上流社会的地下世界“半世俗社会”蓬勃发展。被称为“交际花”（高级妓女）的女性，对文化、政治和经济的一切都施加着深远影响。

1861年某个下雨的夏日清晨，拉隆德爵士在塞纳河上的一座桥边，捡到一名即使被雨淋湿也赤脚走路的美丽女子。然而，她的真实身份是一名男扮女装的男妓，能够令男人疯狂并将他们毁掉。

[翻译自[url=http://burstgen.com/boukoku/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
